rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 4 "There is no last turn": line 30: "The training closes. The flywheel does not." — "the flywheel" is a definite noun phrase used with no prior naming anywhere in the file. The nearest content (lines 27-28: "Each session surfaces the next gap. Each gap proposes the next move. Each move makes the next session cheaper. The kit compounds; the model rotates.") describes the compounding cycle but never uses the word "flywheel" or an equivalent label, so a reader hits a named mechanism at the very last line with nothing to attach it to. Checked training-wide: `grep -rni flywheel curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/ curriculum/lectures/*.md curriculum/exercises/*.md` returns zero hits for this term anywhere in AE101 outside this one line, and it is absent from `curriculum/vocabulary.md` — so the arc-earned-spine-vocabulary carve-out does not cover it (the word 'flywheel' as a training term belongs to Agents 101's `compounding.md`/`agents-building-agents.md`, a different training). The file's own maintainer block (L53, 'Kicker pairing') states that a naming kicker — "The loop feeds itself. That is the flywheel." — sits earlier in this same file to set up the closer; that kicker is not present anywhere in the current 31-line body (confirmed by grep against the raw source), so the pairing the maintainer note describes does not exist in the shipped text. HARM: a reader/room hits "the flywheel" cold on the training's very last projected line with no antecedent to resolve it against — the file's final beat lands as an unexplained metaphor.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Either restore/re-add a naming beat for "the flywheel" earlier in this file (the maintainer note names the missing kicker verbatim), or drop the word from the closer and let the compounding-chain bullet (lines 27-28) carry the claim without a label it never earned.

"The agent stops where your judgement begins" (line 3) is borne out by line 7: "It stops exactly where the writing stops and your judgement takes over." "The right information grounds and makes quality" (line 10) is borne out by line 14: "The goal is giving the system the right information" plus line 12's grounding-in-verification framing. "There is no last turn" (line 25) is borne out verbatim by its own first bullet, line 27. No header is contradicted by its chunk's content.

Closest candidate to the anaphora/epistrophe sub-item: chunk 4 line 27, "Each session surfaces the next gap. Each gap proposes the next move. Each move makes the next session cheaper." — a triple with matching "Each X verb Y" scaffolding. It stays inside the rule because the third leg carries new concrete content (an economic consequence — cost falling — not a restatement of legs 1-2, which name a gap and a move respectively). No "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction found anywhere in the body. No self-grading superlative found (grepped for "one of the most", "most useful", "most important" — none present). The 500K-lines number (line 12) carries no retraction language ("could be more, could be less") and is maintainer-attested per the backing block, so it is not a number-plus-retraction violation. No abstraction-noun stack or empty-leg verb triplet found.
